title: Complete checkout with area autocomplete, shipping rate selection, and order success landing
description: A shopper can fill checkout details, select an area and shipping service, choose a payment method, submit the order, and land on the success page.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Open a product from the product grid
Select a product variant option
Add the product to the cart from the product page
Navigate to /checkout
Fill a customer name into the name field
Fill a valid phone number into the phone field
Fill a valid email address into the email field
Type a city or district name into the area autocomplete field
Select an area from the autocomplete dropdown results
Fill a detailed address into the address field
Wait for available shipping rates to be displayed
Select a shipping courier and service
Select a payment method
Submit the order
Verify the user lands on the checkout success page

title: Add a selected product variant to the cart and adjust quantity with live subtotal updates
description: A shopper can add a product variant to the cart, change quantity up and down, and see the subtotal update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Open a product from the product grid
Select a product variant option
Add the product to the cart from the product page
Navigate to /cart
Increase the cart item quantity by 1
Decrease the cart item quantity by 1
Verify the cart subtotal updates after quantity changes

title: Open cart from homepage using cart shortcut
description: Verifies a guest can open the cart page using the global cart shortcut and land on the cart view.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the cart icon
Verify the cart page is displayed

title: Reach shop from homepage using global header navigation
description: Verifies a guest can use the header navigation from the homepage to reach the shop page and see products displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the header navigation link to view the shop
Verify a product grid or product list is displayed on the shop page

title: Browse catalog with filters and view a product variant on PDP
description: A shopper can filter the shop catalog, open a product detail page, and select a variant option successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Apply the category filter to Eyeglasses
Apply the color filter to Black
Open a product from the product grid
Select a product variant option
Verify product specifications, pricing tiers, and variant options are displayed on the product page

title: Login and reach account dashboard
description: Verifies a returning customer can sign in with valid credentials and land on the account dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the account dashboard

title: Block checkout submission when a required field is missing
description: A shopper who leaves a required checkout field blank sees a validation error and cannot proceed to success.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Open a product from the product grid
Select a product variant option
Add the product to the cart from the product page
Navigate to /checkout
Fill a customer name into the name field
Fill a valid phone number into the phone field
Fill a valid email address into the email field
Type a city or district name into the area autocomplete field
Select an area from the autocomplete dropdown results
Leave the detailed address field empty
Select a payment method
Submit the order
Verify a field-level validation error is visible for the missing required field

title: Register a new account and reach account dashboard
description: Verifies a new customer can register with valid details and land on the account dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill Test User into the name field
Fill testuser+{{RANDOM}}@example.com into the email field
Fill a valid phone number into the phone field
Fill ValidPass123! into the password field
Submit the registration form
Verify the user lands on the account dashboard

title: Show empty results state when filters exclude all products
description: A shopper who applies filters that match no products sees an empty-results message instead of a product grid.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Apply a combination of filters that excludes all products
Verify a no-products-found empty state message is visible

title: Protect account dashboard from unauthenticated access
description: Verifies visiting the account dashboard while logged out redirects the user to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /account
Verify the user is prompted to sign in

title: Navigate to collections via mobile menu
description: Verifies a guest can open the mobile hamburger menu and navigate to the collections page successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Resize the viewport to a mobile width
Click the mobile hamburger menu
Click the navigation link to view collections
Verify the collections page is displayed

title: Protect reseller application route from unauthenticated access
description: Verifies visiting the reseller application page while logged out redirects the user to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /account/become-reseller
Verify the user is prompted to sign in

title: Reject login with invalid credentials
description: Verifies the login form blocks sign-in with incorrect credentials and shows an error state.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill invalid.user@example.com into the email field
Fill WrongPassword123! into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify an authentication error message is visible

title: Remove an item from the cart and see cart recalculated
description: A shopper can remove a cart item and the cart updates with a recalculated subtotal.

steps.description: Navigate to /shop
Open a product from the product grid
Select a product variant option
Add the product to the cart from the product page
Navigate to /cart
Remove the item from the cart
Verify the cart shows an empty state or no longer lists the removed item and the subtotal is recalculated

title: Submit reseller application and see pending confirmation
description: Verifies an authenticated customer can submit a reseller application and sees a pending review confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the reseller application page
Fill the reseller application form with valid business details
Submit the reseller application
Verify a confirmation that the application is pending review is visible

title: Validate required fields on registration
description: Verifies the registration form shows validation errors when required fields are missing.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Submit the registration form
Verify registration field validation errors are visible

title: Submit contact message successfully
description: Verifies a guest shopper can submit the contact form and see a success confirmation state.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill Test Sender into the name field
Fill testsender+{{RANDOM}}@example.com into the email field
Fill Wholesale inquiry into the subject field
Fill I would like more information about wholesale pricing and minimum order. into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify a contact submission success confirmation is visible

title: Request password reset confirmation
description: Verifies a shopper can request a password reset and sees a confirmation state on the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /forgot-password
Fill testuser+reset+{{RANDOM}}@example.com into the email field
Submit the password reset request form
Verify a password reset request confirmation is visible

title: Reseller application requires mandatory fields
description: Verifies the reseller application form blocks submission when required fields are missing and shows validation errors.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the link to open the reseller application page
Submit the reseller application
Verify reseller application validation errors are visible

title: Start WhatsApp contact from floating button
description: Verifies a guest can use the floating WhatsApp button to initiate a WhatsApp contact action.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the floating WhatsApp button
Verify a new tab or window opens to a WhatsApp destination

title: Contact form validates required fields
description: Verifies the contact form shows validation errors when submitted with missing required fields.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Submit the contact form
Verify contact form validation errors are visible

title: Navigate from login to register screen
description: Verifies a shopper can switch from the login screen to the registration screen via the UI navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Click the link to create a new account
Verify the registration form is displayed
